title: Chattarsal Appeals to Jahangir and Turns Toward Malwa

blocks.text: Courtly disorder now drives the next crisis. After his queen shames him and compels sobriety, Chattarsal sets out on a desperate mission summarized in the line jahangir kai ja pau pâi, seeking forgiveness and restoration from the Mughal emperor.

Jahangir refuses to restore his old footing and instead leaves him to make his way by predatory force. From there Chattarsal moves through Bathinda, seeks local advice, and is directed toward the wealth and vulnerability of the Mehraj settlers in Malwa.
The page turns personal humiliation into frontier danger. What begins as a palace rebuke ends with violence being redirected toward a still-fragile settlement world.
